description: Terminates the ML compute instance. Before terminating the instance, SageMaker AI disconnects the ML storage volume from it. SageMaker AI preserves the ML storage volume.

researchLinks.description: Execute Commands on SageMaker Notebook Instance via Lifecycle Configuration
Privilege escalation with SageMaker and there's more hiding in execution roles

securityImplications: Attackers might use StopNotebookInstance to stop a notebook instance so that a malicious lifecycle configuration can be attached, since a lifecycle configuration can only be changed while the instance is stopped.
